issue_context.title: npm packages: respect "repository" field to automatically set repository link of uploaded packages
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

npm packages allow for an "repository" field to add an link to an code repository; this could be used to automatically set the repository link of an package when uploading it.

### Screenshots

_No response_

review_comments:
It's need to be `AppURL` here since `repoUrl` can start with `https://my.domain.tld` which we also need to get rid of.

If this should be changed, we would need to check/remove the protocol & domain seperatly beforehand.

Yes; this method was moved from an anonymous inner function of GetRepositoryByURL which is used to determine the repo by its (git clone) url.

It needs to handle these cases:
```
https://my.domain/sub-path/<owner>/<repo>.git
https://my.domain/sub-path/<owner>/<repo>
git+ssh://user@my.domain/<owner>/<repo>.git
git+ssh://user@my.domain/<owner>/<repo>
user@my.domain:<owner>/<repo>.git
user@my.domain:<owner>/<repo>
```
